parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own IFTTT destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-ifttt` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `ifttt://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two Apprise channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters. Two transformer channels skip Apprise entirely and POST a native IFTTT Webhooks payload directly to maker.ifttt.com: the free `gateway` channel delivers direct to your IFTTT Webhooks endpoint, and the `gateway-plus` channel adds extra per-enrollment IFTTT destinations at $0.001 per message.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment IFTTT destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your IFTTT Webhooks endpoint (no Apprise)
parameters.gateway_url_plus: ${ customer_secrets.IFTTT_WEBHOOK_BASE ?? https://maker.ifttt.com }/trigger/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.event_secret }} }/with/key/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.webhook_id_secret }} }

event_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's IFTTT event name

events_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's IFTTT events

webhook_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's IFTTT webhook id
